title: The Secret Language of Trees
hook: Your backyard trees are secretly talking to each other.
script: Your backyard trees are secretly talking to each other. An underground network of fungi, called mycorrhizal networks, links them up. This network can stretch 500 kilometers in just a cubic meter of soil. Older 'Mother Trees' act as hubs, feeding their young saplings up to 30 meters away. Trees even warn each other of threats, like insect attacks, through chemical signals. Could our communication systems become as resilient as a forest's? What would you choose, a world with tree-like networks or without?
